title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Python / React / AWS)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack to design and build scalable cloud-native applications while leading engineering teams and driving technical decisions.
Requirements
7+ years of software engineering experience.
Candidates should currently reside in Europe or be willing and able to relocate to Europe.
Strong expertise in Python (FastAPI).
Solid experience with ReactJS and TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, REST/GraphQL APIs, and CI/CD.
Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases and asynchronous processing (Celery or similar).
Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives.
Good verbal and writing English language communication skills.

Nice to Have
AI/LLM integration experience.
Kafka, SNS/SQS, Redis, RabbitMQ.
Terraform or CloudFormation.
Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Clean Architecture.
